Since becoming the head of America’s top telecom regulator, Brendan Carr has become well known for his feud with the late-night talk show host Jimmy Kimmel, investigations into several news broadcasters, and his fierce defense of President Donald Trump.

But Carr has quietly brought the same muscularity to a challenge that has energized his career at the Federal Communications Commission: China.
